responsibility: Implements the core IA-64 backend logic behind the target hooks declared in ia64.h and referenced by the md files. This file owns major code-generation and assembly policies for the port, including frame and register-stack layout, prologue/epilogue expansion, move/call/compare/builtin expansion, atomic and vector helper routines, scheduling and bundling support, section and relocation decisions, debug/register mapping, and assorted ABI- and OS-sensitive hooks used by SysV, HP-UX, Linux, and VMS configurations.
same_name_distinction: The executable implementation file for the IA-64 port: unlike ia64.h's compile-time macros/types, ia64.md's RTL pattern definitions, and ia64.opt's option-table declarations, this .cc file contains the C++ target-hook code and helper routines that realize those interfaces at runtime.
